rows.grounds: compound qualifier indicating what comes first; instrumental of means
instrumental of the means employed in the practice
compound describing the state to be effected in the target
imperative command to effect the stated condition

items.question: What means places the target within Manmatha’s power in this enchanting practice?
premises: The practice employs Kama beginning with Vidarbha as its means.
The intended result is a state of being entered within Manmatha.
A repeated imperative commands the effecting of this state.
items.inference: Therefore, by applying the Kama beginning with Vidarbha, the practitioner is to make the target absorbed within Manmatha.
uncertainties: The exact referent of vidarbhī in this ritual context is not specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: By means of Kama beginning with Vidarbha, make the target enter within Manmatha—make it so!
